target_definition: couple in which both partners are age 25-30 and both are working

population_anchor.source_note: UN WPP 2024 medium-variant 2025 five-year age groups; age 30 approximated as one fifth of the 30-34 group. Not a direct official VDA 25-30 count.

partnership_assumption.rationale: 2021 Census first-marriage cumulative rates rise steeply between ages 25 and 30; cohabitation adds partnerships, while age gaps and dissolved unions reduce the share in which both partners are simultaneously 25-30. The 30-45% bracket is deliberately broad.

both_working_assumption.rationale: Conservative joint-employment range around Lithuania's high employment rates in prime-age cohorts; not a directly observed couple-level employment probability.

publication_guidance.recommended_public_wording: 2025 m. Lietuvoje galėjo būti maždaug 23–40 tūkst. porų, kuriose abu partneriai yra 25–30 m. ir abu dirba; centrinis modelio taškas apie 31 tūkst. Tai modeliuotas dydis, ne oficialus porų skaičius.
publication_guidance.reason: 515 SADM recipients are legally defined young families under a broader age/family definition and are not a subset measured with the same target definition.
